_comment: Generic search intent only — this file is public. The personal, profile-aware matching happens on-device in the app.

location_preferences._comment: home = on-site match. commutable_areas = actual towns within daily commuting range of Luxembourg City, NOT whole countries — Paris/Munich/Cologne are technically in neighboring countries but hundreds of km away and not commutable. Add/remove towns to match your real range. eu_wide_remote_ok/worldwide_remote_ok control whether those broader remote tiers count as a fit.

_relevance_comment: min_title_fit/min_keyword_hits are a hard gate: a lead needs real title-word overlap OR this many keyword hits before location/recency count for anything. Without this, a fully-remote EU-wide company's entire job board (any title at all) could pass on proximity and freshness alone — that's how 'Accounts Receivable Clerk' and 'Graduate Talent Scientist' ended up in the inbox.
